name: get_local_time
description: Get the current date, local time and part of day (morning, afternoon, evening, night) for a place. Use it before greeting the user or mentioning the time of day, and whenever you need today's date. Fetch https://exasecond.com/local?tz=<place> and return the text.

place.description: The user's city, country, time zone name or UTC offset, e.g. "Oslo", "Norway", "Europe/Oslo" or "+02:00". Empty for UTC.
